versions.changelog: Complete audit & fix: 16 issues resolved. Hallucinated test-model.sh rewritten to do real connectivity checks. check-prices.sh now generic (no hardcoded model URLs). find-stuck/cleanup-stale/find-stray/show-tree scripts made honest (guidance-only, no fake CLI calls). Fixed path resolution in dashboard (server.py, serve.sh). Sanitized filenames in log-session.sh and init-project.sh (spaces/pipe chars handled). Removed stale test artifacts from skill directory.
Added cross-session resume: session state files (sessions/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-*.md), resume-session.sh script, consistent file naming convention. log-session.sh now writes detailed state for resume.
Fixed data dir path resolution. All 11 scripts tested.
Initial release: model cataloguing, routing, session logging, decision tracking, project onboard, price monitor, dashboard, fresh-install flow.
